name: Freddy Negrete
headline: The Godfather of Prison-Style Black & Grey Chicano Art
bio: Freddy Negrete is credited with bringing prison-style single-needle black & grey tattooing out of juvenile detention centers and into legitimate storefronts. Working with Ed Hardy and Jack Rudy, Negrete legitimized fine line shading and Chicano cultural imagery worldwide. He served as the primary technical tattoo consultant on Hollywood films including 'Blood In, Blood Out'.
awards: Author of Smile Now, Cry Later
Lifetime Pioneer Award at National Tattoo Association

signatureWork.title: Virgen de Guadalupe Chicano Fine Line Shading
